queries.varieties: SELECT COMPANY_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT PRODUCT_CATEGORY_NAME) as total_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SALES_CHANNEL IN ('eCommerce','K2K','API') THEN PRODUCT_CATEGORY_NAME END) as online_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT SALE_ITEM_ID) as total_skus, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SALES_CHANNEL IN ('eCommerce','K2K','API') THEN SALE_ITEM_ID END) as online_skus FROM PRODUCTION.ANALYTICS.SALES_SV WHERE KS_FLAG = TRUE AND SHIPPING_DATE >= '2026-01-01' AND SHIPPING_DATE < '2026-07-01' AND SALES < 100000 GROUP BY COMPANY_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID ORDER BY total_categories DESC
queries.time_depth: SELECT COMPANY_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('day', SHIPPING_DATE, ARRIVAL_DATE) <= 7 THEN SALE_ITEM_ID END) as sold_0_7d, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('day', SHIPPING_DATE, ARRIVAL_DATE) BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN SALE_ITEM_ID END) as sold_8_14d, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('day', SHIPPING_DATE, ARRIVAL_DATE) BETWEEN 15 AND 30 THEN SALE_ITEM_ID END) as sold_15_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('day', SHIPPING_DATE, ARRIVAL_DATE) > 30 THEN SALE_ITEM_ID END) as sold_30plus_d, COUNT(DISTINCT SALE_ITEM_ID) as total_sold FROM PRODUCTION.ANALYTICS.SALES_SV WHERE KS_FLAG = TRUE AND SHIPPING_DATE >= '2026-01-01' AND SHIPPING_DATE < '2026-07-01' AND SALES < 100000 AND SALES_CHANNEL IN ('eCommerce','K2K','API') GROUP BY COMPANY_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID ORDER BY total_sold DESC

notes.varieties: PRODUCT_VARIETY_NAME, VARIETY_NAME, and PRODUCT_NAME do not exist in SALES_SV. Fell back to PRODUCT_CATEGORY_NAME only. Variety-level granularity is unavailable in this view.
notes.time_depth: DELIVERY_DATE does not exist in SALES_SV. Used ARRIVAL_DATE instead. DATEDIFF measures days between SHIPPING_DATE and ARRIVAL_DATE. Online channels = eCommerce, K2K, API (sell-side online per Rule 6).
notes.fan_out_warning: SALES_SV has known fan-out on customer dimensions (Rule 5/16). These queries group by COMPANY_NAME + ACCOUNT_ID and count DISTINCT SALE_ITEM_ID / PRODUCT_CATEGORY_NAME, which avoids the fan-out inflation on category and SKU counts. However, total_skus counts may be inflated if sale_item_id appears across multiple customer_location_id rows. For precise SKU counts, a dedup CTE on sale_item_id would be needed.
